answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 41405 Country: India Title: Can I distribute my zakah amount after Eid during the year Question: Can I distribute my zakah amount after Eid during the year? Answer ID: 41405 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1318/882/H=1433) Yes you can do so but you should try to distribute it as soon as possible.
